name: self-review
description: Factory self-evaluation loop: analyze telemetry (commits, artifacts, verdicts, durations) and per-step context evidence (factory-run context cost/token breakdowns, sampled stream-json transcripts) from past runs, find what works and what doesn't, write an improvement plan, then spawn a full feature-dev graph execution on the app-factory rig to implement, validate, and deploy the improvement live. The plan gate was removed 2026-09-14 (standup default, D29/D31): every app-factory rig run is PR-gated, so the founder reviews the diff on the PR rather than the plan.
